authorization: Released on 18 November by the session that wrote #518, from the owner's accounts. That session wrote no authorization note; this record was written afterwards from the Vercel deployment list, production headers and the session's local review notes.

release.summary: Fixes from a full security review (F1-F19). #519 and #520 only unblock the Vercel build: agent worktrees out of the upload, and the coverage package matched to vitest.
residual: Direct Convex library and analysis reads are not metered (F2).
Owner-preview analysis content is readable through public analysis reads (F3, F21).
Dev-only audit findings in the Vitest/Vite toolchain; production audit is 0.
19 lint warnings from two new react-hooks rules.
release.reviewFindings: CodeRabbit CLI ran seven passes on the diff; every finding was fixed except one false positive. CI quality-gates and CodeRabbit on the PR passed.

steps.convex: Production backend pushed first: listAttention needs the server secret, impression cap, nightly cleanup cron, settlement changes.

steps.vercel: Two attempts failed: the upload hit the symlink in .claude/worktrees and the 15k-file limit, then npm ci refused the lock. Fixed by #519 and #520.

changes: Client IP: x-vercel-forwarded-for under platform trust; the forwarding header is trusted only with declared proxies.
Per-IP limits on session reads (60/min), rate-limit status, image and chat catalogs, video config, readiness and the LNURL proxy; impressions capped at 300/min per image.
listAttention needs the server secret, so reader feedback is no longer public.
Invoice bodies capped at 10 KiB; bulk jobs at 8,192 verses; the public app URL is required in production.
Timing-safe compares for ops tokens and the Convex admin upgrade; nosniff and a sandbox CSP on stored blobs; COOP and CORP.

Settlement: a late charge against a released hold is debited; the picture is saved before charging; an uncertain debit keeps the picture and hold (billingPending). A video retry after a charge completes and records only what was debited.
Nightly cleanup: feedback and admin audit after a year, processed outbox rows after 7 days.

smoke.after: Production sends COOP, CORP and nosniff, and GET /api/session sends private, no-store. A 50 MB invoice gets the platform's 413 and a 20 KB one the app's (exceeds 10000 bytes). image-models gave 30 x 200 then 429; readiness and lnurlp 120 x 200 then 429; session reads count in the session-read bucket. A call to analysis:listAttention without the server secret is refused.
